description: Emits a JSON array of puzzle tasks with objectively checkable answers. Types: sudoku (unique-solution puzzles; answers verified against sudoku rules + givens) and wordsearch (answers verified against the grid letters). Deterministic with --seed, so a (seed, type, difficulty, n) tuple names a reproducible benchmark set.

out.description: Write tasks JSON to a file instead of stdout

seed.description: Seed for a reproducible task set (default: 1)

type.description: Task type: sudoku or wordsearch (default: sudoku)

name: eval_generate
title: eval generate
